{{Quote|They won't need to board us. They'll take us under tow, wait for lack of life support to kill us. It's an old Iska pirate ploy.|Captain of the ''Dewback's Burden''|<ref name="Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>}}
The '''Iska pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were led by the pirate lord [[Guun Cutlax]].
